name: ru-score
description: > Score Russian text 0.0–10.0 across five dimensions: typography, clean language, grammar, structure, precision for the reader. Triggers: оцени текст, ru-score, оценка качества текста, насколько хорош текст, балл за текст. Use when the user wants a number rather than a list of findings. Never edits a file.
author: talkstream
